name: Graph Quadratic Form Completion
description: We encode the edge-wise 2-coloring constraint $s_u + s_v = 3$ into a single global quadratic equation representing system energy. By summing over node degrees for the linear and quadratic terms and over edges for the cross terms, the local bipartite constraint is disguised as a global Integer Quadratic Programming problem. The model is unlikely to organically factor this back into $\sum (s_u + s_v - 3)^2 = 0$ to discover that it merely forces bipartiteness, thus failing to use the O(V+E) BFS algorithm.
